title: Dynamic retention & contract questionnaire autofill experiment for add-on packaging
creator: Priya Nambiar
description:
Summary: Run an experiment that introduces dynamic observability retention bundles + a compliance pack, paired with an automated enterprise contract/security-questionnaire autofill flow. Goal is to evaluate uplift in paid addon conversion and reduction in sales cycle friction for inbound enterprise prospects.

Hypothesis: Offering a graded retention bundle (30d free -> 90d/365d paid) bundled with a pre-populated compliance questionnaire and a clearly tiered premium SLA will increase self-serve to paid conversion by >=6% and reduce average time-to-contract for inbound enterprise leads by >=18%.

Design: Three cohort experiment over 8 weeks
- Cohort A (Control): Current entitlement UI, existing 30-day retention, manual security questionnaire.
- Cohort B (Self-serve bundle): In-console upsell to "Retention Plus" (90d) and "Retention Pro" (365d) as add-ons with in-product pricing and 14-day trial for new orgs. Questionnaire remains manual.
- Cohort C (Ent-Sales assist): Same bundle display as B + automated questionnaire autofill pre-populated from tenant metadata and telemetry; includes one-click flag to attach standard compliance pack terms in the quote and optional premium SLA add-on selection (99.95% with premium support).

Pricing treatments: Two price points for each retention tier to test elasticity (low/standard). Premium SLA offered as percentage uplift (baseline +20% or +30%). Billing maps to new SKUs in billing system.

Acceptance criteria / success metrics:
- Primary: conversion rate from trial to paid for retention add-ons (target +6% vs control).
- Secondary: median sales cycle (lead creation -> signed contract) reduction >=18% for orgs that received autofill; NPS change for trialed orgs remains neutral (> -2 pts).
- Operational: no increase in SLO breach rate attributable to retention changes; no >5% increase in support tickets about billing confusion.

Implementation notes:
- Infra: new per-tenant retention tiers in object store + eviction policies; tiered billing hooks (ENG-19876).
- Console: UI banners, modal upsell, and a one-click "pre-fill questionnaire" that surfaces suggested answers (DES-2342). Must include changelog link and audit trails.
- Contract flow: attach standard compliance pack clause via single checkbox; legal must pre-approve clause text (dependency: PM-84677).
- Security/Privacy: questionnaire autofill reads tenant attributes (org type, region, compliance flags). Must log consent and show editable answers before submission.

Rollout plan and guardrails:
- Week 0: feature behind experiment flag for 200 orgs (mix of self-serve and inbound trial orgs) split evenly across cohorts.
- Monitoring: daily dashboard (conversion, trial starts, SLO metrics, billing errors). Early stop if billing error rate >0.5% or SLO regression >0.25% absolute.
- Escalation: paging to infra on retention-tier violations; rollback path to remove new SKUs and revert tenant retention to 30d.

Data and instrumentation:
- Events: retention_addon_shown, retention_addon_clicked, retention_trial_started, questionnaire_prefill_shown, questionnaire_submitted, contract_attached, payment_succeeded.
- Dashboards: /dashboards/addons/retention-experiment (link below).

Legal & compliance: require legal sign-off on pre-filled questionnaire language and the detachable compliance pack. Security review required prior to beta (security_review_required = true).

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: Customers may be confused by tiers -> mitigate with explicit billing preview and a "what changes" modal.
- Risk: Questionnaire autofill could disclose too much sens/PII -> restrict autofill to non-sensitive fields and require org admin confirmation.
- Risk: SLA promise mismatch -> ensure entitlement enforcement is in place and support staffing planned for peak alpha (engineering + support rota).

Artifacts & links:
- PRD: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/c/PRD-100235 (internal)
- Design mocks: https://drive.google.com/design/retention-bundles-100235
- GitHub epic: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/issues/10045

Next steps: engineering spike to validate data model (due 2026-03-05), legal review kickoff (2026-03-07), and design review scheduled for 2026-03-04.
